description: Floats content beside an anchor element and keeps it there as the page moves.

tags.devx:
- Internal building block for `Tooltip`; not yet documented as a
  standalone public component.
- Portals `children` to `document.body`.
tags.a11y:
- Renders no semantics of its own; the caller's content and `Tooltip`'s
  own `role="tooltip"` carry accessibility meaning.
tags.limitations:
- Falls back to tracking `getBoundingClientRect()` on scroll and resize
  in browsers without native CSS Anchor Positioning support.

position.name: position
position.description: Placement of the floating element relative to its anchor. `auto` chooses below/above or right/left from the anchor's viewport half. Defaults to `bottom`.

autoAxis.name: autoAxis
autoAxis.description: Axis used by automatic placement. Defaults to `vertical`.

anchorRef.name: anchorRef
anchorRef.description: The element the floating content is positioned relative to.
